background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean production background scenery for the landscape Maths vs Zombies educational game, no interface. Generate an ultrawide landscape image approximately 2048x944 (aspect 2.16:1). Image 1 is a STYLE reference only: preserve its polished detailed family-friendly 3D storybook fantasy rendering and coherent stone architecture, while completely replacing the sunny palace/waterfall setting with a spooky moonlit graveyard. Strong unmistakable graveyard: varied weathered tombstones, fresh earth grave mounds, crooked wrought-iron cemetery fence, ancient mausoleum and ruined gothic towers receding into blue-violet night, bare twisted trees, cold green-blue wisps amongst the graves, a pale moon behind thin cloud. Rich sapphire-indigo shadows and restrained old gold/amber lantern light compatible with the game's sapphire-and-gold UI. Clearly readable silhouettes, atmospheric depth, beautiful detailed materials, eerie and magical, child-friendly rather than graphic horror. CAMERA/COMPOSITION: front-facing side-on battle stage, near-level camera. All graves and upright scenery must stay BEHIND the broad unobstructed horizontal battle lane. The open slate-stone and earth ground starts at about 54% image height and extends fully across to the bottom. The character foot contact line is a single straight horizontal line at about 67% image height, with a low curb or lighting seam making the floor easy to read. Flat walkable foreground, no pits, no foreground wall cutting across the actors. Keep middle area from x10-90% and y34-67% uncluttered for separate hero and zombie sprites. Leave dark calm sky in upper quarter behind separate HUD/question UI. Lower quarter is quiet paving suitable behind separate answer buttons and bottom controls. Graves visibly frame the action behind the lane and at its back edges, not hidden exclusively behind future HUD. Wide, grounded, immersive haunted cemetery. NO characters, NO zombies, NO bats (these will be independently animated), NO text, NO writing on gravestones, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO UI, NO panels, NO buttons, NO decorative HUD frames, NO baked-in controls, NO collage, NO masks. Fill the full canvas with one continuous environment.

bat.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game sprite for animated bats in a moonlit fantasy graveyard. Image 1 is the existing bat sprite and style reference. Create a new front-facing symmetrical flying pose of this same believable dark slate-blue bat, with the whole body precisely centred and both wings spread almost horizontally, each wing fully visible. Small natural furry central body, tiny warm eyes, pointed ears, elegant angular finger bones and detailed blue-violet wing membranes. Preserve the reference's polished detailed 3D game-asset style and natural bat anatomy, suitable for a family-friendly spooky fantasy game. The body occupies the middle approximately 15% of total width; wing roots meet the body near x44% and x56%, around y50%. Keep the two wings clearly separable from the narrow central body so each can be articulated independently. Horizontal wing silhouette, roughly 2.3 times wider than tall, centred in a landscape canvas. No flight trails or glow, no cast shadow outside the bat, no scenery, no text, no frame, no extra bats. A single isolated full bat on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background with clean antialiased alpha edges, no black rectangle or checkerboard baked in.

inspection: Both outputs opened and inspected before integration. New scenery contains no UI or actors. Bat has genuine transparent alpha. Production processing is WebP conversion plus transparent-margin trim and aspect-preserving downscale for the bat. Original generation files remain intact. See zombie-graveyard-assets.json for exact dimensions, crops and hashes.
